Tiburtino Nord — Rome, Italy

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

Tiburtino Nord is part of the wider Tiburtino public-housing district built up around Via Tiburtina in the mid-20th century, mostly low- and mid-rise residential blocks. Searches did not turn up incidents specifically tied to 'Tiburtino Nord' by name; most local crime coverage under the general 'Tiburtino' tag concerns nearby Casal Bruciato or the adjoining Tiburtino III zone, where a drug-dealing operation was dismantled and a pusher was found carrying a firearm. No specific daytime safety concerns were documented for this zone itself, but given the presence of drug-related issues in adjoining parts of the same historic Tiburtino housing complex, a cautious yellow applies at night.
